info.name: Telnyx Access Tokens Usage Reports (BETA) API

params.name: start_date
params.description: The start date for the time range you are interested in. The maximum time range is 31 days. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end date for the time range you are interested in. The maximum time range is 31 days. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

params.name: date_range
params.description: A more user-friendly way to specify the timespan you want to filter by. More options can be found in the Telnyx API Reference docs.

params.name: managed_accounts
params.description: Return the aggregations for all Managed Accounts under the user making the request.

params.name: sort
params.description: Specifies the sort order for results

params.name: format
params.description: Specify the response format (csv or json). JSON is returned by default, even if not specified.

params.name: page
params.description: Consolidated page parameter (deepObject style). Originally: page[number], page[size]

items.docs: Get Telnyx usage data by product, broken out by the specified dimensions

params.name: product
params.description: Options (dimensions and metrics) for a given product. If none specified, all products will be returned.

items.docs: Get the Usage Reports options for querying usage, including the products available and their respective metrics and dimensions
